tagline: One endpoint in front of every model your applications use.
summary: A self-hosted, multi-tenant LLM gateway: one key and the OpenAI API shape in front of every model your applications use. The edge gateway is Go 1.26 on Fiber v2, with provider plugins, analytics, and a conformance suite that runs in CI.
highlights: Speaks the OpenAI API shape, so existing clients point at one gateway endpoint and keep working.
Multi-tenant by design: tenants get their own keys in front of every upstream provider.
A conformance suite runs against the gateway in CI, not just at release time.
